column8: Evidence

column4: Is there a designated officer for NIS2 compliance?
column8: No designated NIS2 compliance officer; responsibility informally held by Practice Manager; no appointment record.

column4: Does the board explicitly approve cyber measures?
column8: No board-level cyber oversight; directors rely on the IT managed-service provider (MSP); no cyber item in board minutes.

column4: Is there an approved cyber budget for 18 months?
column8: No ring-fenced cyber budget; security spend bundled into the monthly MSP retainer (MSP-CON-2024).

column4: Do board members undergo mandatory cyber training?
column8: No board or director cyber-governance training undertaken.

column4: Is there a documented Security Policy (ISMS)?
column8: Generic acceptable-use and IT policy supplied by MSP template (MSP-POL-001); not tailored or formally adopted.

column4: Does policy cover all NIS2 risk areas?
column8: MSP template covers acceptable use and basic access; supply chain, cryptography, continuity and measurement areas absent.

column4: Are risk assessments conducted annually?
column8: MSP performs informal annual review; no documented ISO 27005-style risk assessment owned by the clinic.

column4: Are critical assets (e.g., EHR) formally identified?
column8: Key systems known informally (PACS/RIS, billing); no formal critical-asset register or classification.

column4: Are measures audited/tested annually?
column8: No independent control audit or effectiveness testing on record.

column4: Is there a process to update measures post-incident?
column8: MSP applies fixes reactively after issues; no documented post-incident review owned by the clinic.

column4: Is patching performed within defined SLAs?
column8: MSP applies OS/security patching under managed-service SLA (MSP-SLA-2024, monthly cycle); clinic does not verify independently.

column4: Are backups tested for restorability annually?
column8: MSP runs cloud backups; clinic has never witnessed or signed off a restore test.

column4: Is cyber hygiene training mandatory for all staff?
column8: Ad-hoc phishing awareness emails; no mandatory enrolment or completion tracking.

column4: Is the asset inventory up-to-date?
column8: MSP holds a partial device list; no clinic-maintained, reconciled inventory.

column4: Are background checks performed for sensitive roles?
column8: Pre-employment checks for clinical staff via HR; references and qualification checks retained.

column4: Are access rights revoked immediately upon exit?
column8: Leaver access removal raised by email to MSP; no SLA, occasional delays observed.

column4: Is MFA enforced for ALL remote/admin access?
column8: MFA enabled on Microsoft 365 email and VPN; not enforced on PACS/RIS admin or MSP remote-management tooling.

column4: Is 'Least Privilege' strictly enforced?
column8: Some role separation between clinical and admin staff; shared and over-privileged accounts still common; no least-privilege review.

column4: Are physical server rooms secured?
column8: Primary systems hosted in MSP/cloud data centre with physical security; on-site comms cabinet lockable.

column4: Is patient data encrypted at rest?
column8: Cloud-hosted data encrypted by provider default; local imaging shares and some endpoints unencrypted.

column4: Is data encrypted in transit (TLS)?
column8: HTTPS/TLS for hosted applications and portal; SFTP for external image exchange.

column4: Do supplier contracts include security SLAs?
column8: MSP master services agreement exists but lacks explicit security SLAs, breach-notification or right-to-audit clauses.

column4: Are critical vendors risk-assessed?
column8: MSP and software vendors not formally risk-assessed; no due-diligence questionnaires retained.

column4: Is security built into system acquisition?
column8: Informal vendor selection considers data-handling at a basic level; no documented secure-acquisition gate.

column4: Is there a documented Incident Response Plan?
column8: No clinic-owned incident response plan; assumption that the MSP 'will handle it'.

column4: Has the IRP been tested (tabletop) in 12 months?
column8: No incident exercise or tabletop ever conducted.

column4: Can you submit an 'Early Warning' within 24h?
column8: No capability or process to submit a 24h NIS2 early warning; no awareness of CSIRT contact route.

column4: Are detection mechanisms (IDS/SIEM) in place?
column8: MSP provides basic endpoint protection and log monitoring; no clinic visibility of alerts or coverage.

column4: Is there a Business Continuity Plan with RTOs?
column8: No business continuity plan with RTO/RPO; downtime procedures undocumented.

column4: Are DR procedures tested annually?
column8: No disaster-recovery test performed or evidenced.
